title: Presence-table sparse mask
formula: prob_t[k,q] = exp(score_t[k,q] - rowmax[q]) if query q selects key k else 0; present_t[k,q] = 1.0 or 0.0 for that same selection; denom[q] = sum_k prob_t[k,q]; float32 [1024,64] transposed scores, int32 [64,64] selected columns (1024 means no key) and float32 [1,64] running maximum -> float32 [1024,64] prob_t and present_t plus float32 [1,64] denom
study_for: A mask that is not known until the data arrives, kept as ordinary data and rebuilt with one `compare` instead of stored as a predicate. Grep `reg_to_ub_scatter` in kernel.py: a marker is scattered to each selected key column, and the read side compares it back. The table costs 32 times the bytes of packed predicate bits, which is why it covers a chunk of key columns and is rebuilt per chunk. Take the trade for the reason it was actually made — recompute beats resident on this device, measured in the production kernel this pattern comes from as 722 us of rebuild against 161 us of cube work — and not for the reason it warns against: the backend prints `vf.mask_to_ub` and `vf.ub_to_mask` (library `262d6d6`), so a spilled predicate is possible and still the worse design.

Generation markers instead of clearing. The value written is the chunk's generation number, so a residue from an earlier chunk carries an earlier number and `EQ` misses it — a cleared table with no clearing pass. Grep `EPOCHS` and `_clear_presence`: the real clear runs only when the counter wraps.

One unsigned subtract and one `< CHUNK` classify every index slot at once — below this chunk (wrapped to something enormous), above it, and the reserved padding value. The result goes straight into `reg_to_ub_scatter(..., mask=live)`; the shape this replaced spent two `select`s rewriting rejected indices to a scratch column, and dropping the mask is an out-of-range store rather than a slower kernel. `GUARD = 1` is the spare table row hedging the same edge, and it was measured rather than asserted: with `GUARD = 0` the board returns a bit-identical answer, so at this size the row is not load-bearing. The simulator could not have settled that — it applies the mask first and range-checks only the surviving lanes.

The masked-write table in one body: `expsub(numerator, row, ceiling, live)` zeroes the lanes it turns off, which IS the masking — no second pass zeroes the absent keys, and the row sum accumulates them with no further guard. A masked `dup` three lines below builds the exact 0/1 `present_t` output the same way. Read it with the library's `docs/api/mask-write-semantics.md`.

Why an exactly-compared output earns its place. This unit publishes the rebuilt predicate as `present_t` and main.py compares it EXACTLY rather than folding it into the exponential's tolerance — and that is what made library M10-077 findable: the PyPTO Pro printer was dropping the mask from a masked scalar `vf.dup`, so `present_t` came back 1.0 in all 65536 cells while `prob_t`, whose mask the printer did carry, was right to one ULP. Under a tolerance the wrong predicate would have been a wrong number nobody questioned. Publish the thing you are asserting.
do_not_copy_when: You are taking the chunk width. 128 key columns is narrow on purpose, so that eight rebuilds fit a small unit and the generation counter wraps once. A real attention kernel has cube work between rebuilds, so each rebuild is its own `@vf` entry, and the entry plus its tail barrier puts the floor nearer 512 columns.
You need both vector sub-blocks. This is one core, one sub-block, no `dual_mode` anywhere; for that axis read attention.a5_v8_cube_stage.

You want the smallest table. This one is `uint32` so that the marker register and the score register share a lane width and one predicate serves both. A 16-bit table halves the bytes and then owes a `mask_pack`, because a b16 `compare` writes different physical predicate bits than a b32 consumer reads.

You want a performance figure. Nothing in this folder was timed: the geometry was chosen to make the failure modes observable, not to match a production shape, and the 722/161 us pair quoted above belongs to the production kernel rather than to this stage.
